name: web-addoor-agency-hero-red-motion-blur-portrait-with-stats
title: Addoor creative agency hero: red-orange motion-blurred portrait with stats and condensed caps
whatItIs: A red-orange hero with a woman in profile whose hair smears with motion blur, a ghosted 'DIRECTION' word behind, '90% Success Rate' and '98% Community Trust' stats, white condensed 'Visual stories that define brands', a 'Book a call' button, a 95% review badge and a small card with a founder photo.
whatItMeans: Bold and cinematic; one hot colour and motion blur feel fast and fearless.
techniques: Blur part of a portrait to create motion.
Bathe everything in one saturated hue.
Scatter small stats and labels like HUD data.

vocabulary.definition: An image tinted almost entirely in one colour.
Heads-up display: small data overlays around a view.
